metadata.name: Sticky Pull Request Comment
metadata.description: Create comment on pull request, if exists update that comment.
metadata.author: marocchino

inputs.name: header
inputs.description: Header to determine if the comment is to be updated, not shown on screen. It can be used when you want to add multiple comments independently at the same time.

inputs.name: append
inputs.description: Indicate if new comment messages should be appended to previous comment message. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

inputs.name: recreate
inputs.description: Indicate if previous comment should be removed before creating a new comment. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

inputs.name: delete
inputs.description: delete the previously created comment. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

inputs.name: only_create
inputs.description: only create a new comment if there is no existing one, otherwise do nothing. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it. This options has higher priority than hide_and_recreate, hide.

inputs.name: only_update
inputs.description: only update a exist comment if there is existing one, otherwise do nothing. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

inputs.name: hide_details
inputs.description: hide summary tags in the previously created comment. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

inputs.name: hide
inputs.description: hide previously created comment. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

inputs.name: hide_and_recreate
inputs.description: Indicate if previous comment should be hide before creating a new comment. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

inputs.name: hide_classify
inputs.description: The reasons a piece of content can be reported or minimized. SPAM, ABUSE, OFF_TOPIC, OUTDATED, DUPLICATE, RESOLVED.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: glob path to file(s) containing comment message

inputs.name: ignore_empty
inputs.description: Indicates whether to ignore missing or empty messages

inputs.name: skip_unchanged
inputs.description: only update or recreate if message is different from previous. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

inputs.name: follow_symbolic_links
inputs.description: Indicates whether to follow symbolic links for path

inputs.name: number
inputs.description: pull request number for push event

inputs.name: owner
inputs.description: Another repo owner, If not set, the current repo owner is used by default. Note that when you trying changing a repo, be aware that GITHUB_TOKEN should also have permission for that repository.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: Another repo name limited use on github enterprise. If not set, the current repo is used by default. Note that When you trying changing a repo, be aware that GITHUB_TOKEN should also use that repo's.

inputs.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
inputs.description: The GitHub access token (e.g. secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN) used to create or update the comment. This defaults to {{ github.token }}.

outputs.name: previous_comment_id
outputs.description: ID of previous comment, if found

outputs.name: created_comment_id
outputs.description: ID of newly created comment, if any

diagnostics.message: unknown key `github-token` in the action's metadata is ignored
